scope: New development-only iteration after the original real-docs-v3 experiment was closed. Original test outputs have previously been seen; they are not a fresh holdout for future tuning.
authorization: User requested failure analysis and further optimization on dev only; test stays untouched.
hypothesis: Answer-only anchored extraction preserves entities, conditions and event granularity; a separate fixed-claim evidence judgment reduces lost premises and permits grounded arithmetic without silently changing claims.
dev_drivers: python-sqlite3: unresolved subjects and conditions contribute to alignment losses
sqlite-deterministic and python-decimal: event splitting and duplicate paraphrases
sqlite-partialindex: source-grounded arithmetic incorrectly treated as external knowledge
scoring: Unchanged automatic scorer and gold. No reviewed score replaces the automatic metric. Diagnose scorer/reference artifacts separately; no number normalization or evidence-span edits in this iteration.
access: Existing login only, no credential export or new purchase
quality_comparison: Primary comparison on the same case/repeat intersection after excluding upstream_timeout/upstream_error. All other request failures remain penalties. Also retain all-attempt metrics and report exclusions and selection bias.
decision_rule: Call v4 promising only if common-case automatic E2E F1 improves, verdict macro-F1 does not decline, and targeted failures improve without new confirmed false-supported judgments. Report paired family uncertainty and latency/token cost; no automatic production promotion.
iteration_limit: One v4 candidate and one fresh baseline pass; no retries of availability failures. Additional candidates require a separately recorded rationale and protocol before inference.
review_type: author self-review (AI-assisted), not independent human adjudication
